serverInfo.name: AION Indian Market Intelligence for Macro Event & Sector Impact Analysis

instructions: Use this integration to call AION Indian Market Intelligence for Macro Event & Sector Impact Analysis. Macro-event and sector impact intelligence for Indian financial markets. Structured analysis of how policy, economic, weather, and geopolitical events affect Indian market sectors. This is an MCP-compatible Indian market intelligence client for macro event analysis, sector impact analysis, policy impact analysis, financial event intelligence, market monitoring, and AI agent workflows. An API key is required through the AION_API_KEY environment variable. This system is quota-controlled and does not generate executable orders.
